turns.teacher: Good morning children. Today we will do subtraction with our bundles and sticks. Our first sum is fifty two minus twenty seven. Everyone try it in your notebook.
turns.label: new_sum

turns.teacher: Rabi, you wrote 35. Can you tell me how you got 35? What did you do in the ones column?
turns.label: ask_to_explain

turns.teacher: Okay, so you did seven minus two, because seven is bigger. Ravi, in fifty two, which number is on top in the ones place, 2 or 7?
turns.label: targeted_question

turns.teacher: Yes, 2 is on top. Now Ravi, come here. Make fifty two with bundles. Five bundles of ten and two loose sticks. Can you take away seven loose sticks from only these two?
turns.label: concrete_materials

turns.teacher: Not enough, na? So what can we do? Open one bundle, Ravi. Now how many loose sticks do you have?
turns.label: concrete_materials

turns.teacher: Twelve sticks, very good. You opened the bundle instead of turning the sum upside down. That is exactly the right idea. Now take away seven and count the tens left.
turns.label: specific_praise

turns.teacher: Sana, I saw you writing quietly. Would you like to tell us what answer you got?
turns.label: invite_quiet_child

turns.teacher: Thumbs up if you also got twenty five like Sana and Ravi's sticks. Mina, Arjoon, show me your thumbs.
turns.label: check_whole_class

turns.teacher: Now one more. Forty three minus eighteen. Ravi, you use the bundles again and check the ones column first.
turns.label: new_sum
